output.brief: Cancelling RotaWeave is not supported. The drop comes from two changes acting together at Dock Street and Westgate. The app (Basic tier) has no recurring bookings, so regulars keep a weekly slot only if staff book it before the Thursday release. Staff did that for about 74 bookings a week until the coordinators left on 1 May, and about 3 a week after. Regulars then lost their usual slots to new sign-ups, and 88% of those who lost a slot twice or more are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept theirs. Controls: Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and held steady (118 to 111). Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, and kept paper rosters (86 to 80). Background checks are not the main driver: 121 of the 123 who lapsed had a current check. Commonplate looks minor, since only 2 of the 61 people reached by phone had joined another group. Next steps: put an admin seat to use at Dock Street and Westgate, book regulars into their usual slots before each release, phone lapsed regulars to offer slots back, and review after 60 days. Plan for the Quarry Lane go-live on 6 Oct so it doesn't repeat this. Don't cancel the contract, suspend checks (the county and insurer require them), or purge the roster. Confidence is fairly high, but the evidence is observational.
